title: Undercover Maneuver
next_chapter_hook: Su Qingyao brings news: Ling Yuan was once the junior brother of a Tianji Record holder a hundred years ago

text.content:
Ling Yuan's smile echoed through the Void, yet Chen Ji sensed a warning deep within the Tianji Record—the price of this transaction was far heavier than it appeared.

He lowered his gaze, concealing thatedge within the depths of his eyes. The corner of his lips curved into a perfect blend of fear and gratitude as he bowed: "Disciple... will certainly not disappoint the Sect Master's expectations." His voice trembled slightly, resembling a lucky fool who had just been struck by a windfall.

Satisfied, Ling Yuan nodded and turned to leave. The moment that elderly silhouette vanished at the end of the Corridor, Chen Ji slowly straightened. A cold light flickered across his gaze, gone in an instant.

The real show had just begun.

dialogue.content:
The second watch, Bamboo Grove at the Rear Mountain.

Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back beneath the moonlight, his black robe fluttering in the night wind. His spiritual sense, like invisible threads, quietly explored the surroundings—no energy fluctuations within three li. Su Qingyao's concealment technique was truly remarkable.

Moments later, a green shadow swept out from the bamboo shadows, landing five chi before him. It was Su Qingyao, her face cold as ice under the moonlight, only a subtle heaviness hidden between her brows.

"Are you insane?" she whispered, "You actually accepted Ling Yuan's proposal?"

"Not crazy, how could I deceive him?"

Chen Ji smiled faintly, drawing a Jade Slip from his sleeve and offering it to her: "This is part of the result from my deduction just now. Eight-tenths of what Ling Yuan said about cooperation is true—but that remaining two-tenths of falsehood is enough to destroy us."

Su Qingyao took the Jade Slip, her spiritual sense probing within. After a moment, her beautiful eyes widened: "You used the Tianji Record to deduce his timing of betrayal?"

"Three times." Chen Ji raised three fingers. "Three deductions, three different methods of betrayal. He's more complex than I imagined."

text.content:
Deep within the Bamboo Grove, moonlight poured down like silver gauze. Chen Ji's gaze was heavy as still water, his mind racing through the visions the Tianji Record had displayed—

First deduction: In three days, using "guiding martial techniques" as a pretext, Ling Yuan would lead Chen Ji into the sect's Forbidden Grounds and eliminate him using the grounds' power.

Second deduction: Half a month later during the Sect Competition, Ling Yuan would deliberately arrange for Chen Ji to face a powerful opponent at the Golden Core stage, killing him with a borrowed blade.

The third deduction was most bizarre—the image was blurred beyond recognition, only vaguely showing Ling Yuan standing before an ancient altar, murmuring to a vertical pupil.

The shape of that vertical pupil... matched the terrifying aura deep within the Tianji Record... perfectly.

dialogue.content:
"What are you thinking?" Su Qingyao's voice pulled him back from contemplation.

Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, his tone terrifyingly calm: "I'm thinking about how to make him believe I'm so foolishly hopeless."

He turned to face Su Qingyao directly: "I need you to do two things. First, use your intelligence network within the sect to investigate all of Ling Yuan's activity records from a hundred years ago, especially his contacts with outsiders. Second—"

His voice dropped sharply: "Investigate whether there's some connection between him and the 'Eye of Heavenly Dao.'"

Su Qingyao's pupils contracted upon hearing this: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao? Where did you hear this name?"

"The Tianji Record told me."

Chen Ji didn't hide it. He extended his palm, where a phantom fragment glowing with eerie light appeared. On the fragment, a vertical pupil pattern was faintly visible—identical to what he had seen in the deduction vision.

"This thing..." Su Qingyao drew a sharp breath, "Was it originally part of the Tianji Record, or was it contaminated later?"

"I'm not sure. But there's a similar aura on Ling Yuan."

Chen Ji's voice was very light, yet it made Su Qingyao's heart sink heavily.

text.content:
Su Qingyao fell silent for a moment, then suddenly raised her hand. A sound-isolation formation enveloped both of them.

"Since you've mentioned this, I'll tell you something too." Her voice dropped extremely low. "Ling Yuan... he's not an ordinary Transformed God stage cultivator. Thirty years ago, there was an incident in the sect. The official story was a Demonic Path attack, but few truly know what happened."

"What happened in that incident?"

"The previous Sect Master—Ling Yuan's senior brother—died in his own secret chamber." Su Qingyao spoke word by word. "The death was bizarre; his eyes were gouged out by someone. At the wound site... there was a vertical pupil-shaped burn mark."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently.

In that instant, he recalled the warning from deep within the Tianji Record—the price of this transaction was far heavier than it appeared.

And now, it seemed he had touched merely the tip of that price.

choice.prompt: The connection between Ling Yuan and the "Eye of Heavenly Dao" is far more complex than anticipated. Chen Ji must decide on his next course of action.

choices.description: Approach Ling Yuan under the pretext of请教功法, get close to sense his aura, verify the Heavenly Fate Bloodline speculation
choices.visible_reward: Gain key intelligence, potentially expose Ling Yuan's true identity
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's schemes run extremely deep; once his intentions are detected, the consequences would be unimaginable

dialogue.content: "Are you insane!" Su Qingyao grabbed his wrist, "Ling Yuan is an old monster at the Transformed God stage. You're just at Foundation Building—going to test him?"

text.content: "Atrash has its advantages." Chen Ji gently freed himself from her grip, a faint smile curving his lips, "The more he underestimates me, the easier it is for him to reveal flaws." His eyes flickered with cunning, "Besides... I only want to get close enough to smell his scent, not actually fight him."

choices.description: Let Su Qingyao mobilize her intelligence network for a thorough investigation while Chen Ji remains stationary, waiting for the right moment
choices.visible_reward: Proceed steadily and carefully, avoid alerting the target
choices.risk_hint: May miss the critical window period

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao slightly nodded, a flash of approval in her eyes: "You're more composed than I thought." Her fingers traced several talisman patterns in the air, "I have a group of death warriors under me, distributed throughout the sect. Give me three days."

text.content:
Chen Ji nodded, yet drew out a jade bottle from his chest and offered it to her: "This is a Concentration Elixir. It can save lives at critical moments. You've used the Tianji Record for deep deduction—your spiritual power consumption is considerable. Don't push yourself."

Su Qingyao took the jade bottle, her fingertips trembling slightly. This man who always calculated everything meticulously was actually concerned about her physical condition?

dialogue.content:
Just as the atmosphere grew subtly tense, Chen Ji suddenly frowned.

He abruptly raised his hand, pulling Su Qingyao into his embrace while his body blasted backward three zhang. The next instant, a sharp sword qi swept through where they had stood moments ago, severing several emerald bamboo stalks at their waists.

"Who goes there?" Su Qingyao broke free from Chen Ji's arm, a gleaming sword already in her hand.

Under the moonlight, a gaunt figure slowly emerged from the bamboo shadows. The person wore a plain gray robe, his aged face serene and composed—the manager of the Tianqing Sect's Miscellaneous Affairs Hall, Elder Zhou.

"『Zhou Guanshi?』 Su Qingyao's brow furrowed slightly. 『What brings you here so late at night?』

Zhou Bo's gaze swept over Chen Ji, finally landing on Su Qingyao's face. His turbid eyes flickered with a gleam of sharpness: 『Su Senior Fellow, the old one was ordered by the Sect Master to deliver something to Chen Ji.』

He produced a jade bottle from his sleeve: 『This is the Sect Master's precious Foundation Building Pill, specially granted to Chen Ji, to commend his 『meritorious service』 today.』

Chen Ji accepted the jade bottle, his divine sense quietly probing within—the elixir's quality was top-notch, absolutely no problem. But it was precisely this 『no problem』 that sent a chill creeping into his heart.

Was Ling Yuan... testing him? Or showing goodwill?

text.content:
"『Many thanks, Zhou Guanshi.』 Chen Ji bowed respectfully, his posture impeccable. 『Please convey the disciple's gratitude to the Sect Master's generous kindness on my behalf.』

Zhou Bo gazed at him deeply, his lips parting as if to speak, but ultimately he simply nodded and vanished into the night.

Only after his figure had completely disappeared did Su Qingyao speak: 『This person... is no simple matter.』

『You noticed?』

『His aura is restrained to the extreme—even I cannot fully see through it.』 A solemn light flashed in Su Qingyao's beautiful eyes. 『When did the Tianqing Sect's Service Hall recruit such an expert?』

Chen Ji offered no answer, merely lowering his head to stare at the jade bottle in his palm, lost in contemplation.

Ling Yuan's moves were more bizarre than he'd anticipated. Was this elixir a genuine reward, or some kind of mark?

choice.prompt: The intent behind Ling Yuan's delivery of the Foundation Building Pill remains unclear. Chen Ji must decide how to handle this 『reward.』

choices.description: Publicly consume the elixir to demonstrate having no suspicions toward Ling Yuan, further reinforcing the 『fool』 persona
choices.visible_reward: Further gain Ling Yuan's trust, infiltrate deeper
choices.risk_hint: If the elixir has hidden dangers, the consequences will be severe

dialogue.content:
『He wants to see me eat it, so I'll eat it for him to see.』 Chen Ji poured the elixir into his palm and swallowed it without hesitation. In the next instant, a wave of warmth rose from his abdomen, gently nourishing his meridians.

『How do you feel?』 Su Qingyao asked nervously.

『Very good.』 A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. 『The elixir is fine—at least for the short term. Ling Yuan wanted to use this pill to mark me, but he doesn't know that the Tianji Record protects my body. No evil can escape its notice.』

choices.description: Seal the elixir, silently collect Ling Yuan's leverage
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial material evidence that can later serve to expose Ling Yuan
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may detect your caution

dialogue.content:
『Clever.』 Su Qingyao took the jade bottle, her fingertips emanating a faint spiritual light. 『I know an elixir grandmaster who can analyze the elixir's composition. If there's truly a problem, this will be ironclad evidence.』

Chen Ji nodded: 『But be careful, don't spook the snake. Have that grandmaster investigate under the pretense of exchanging elixir techniques, conduct it secretly.』

text.content:
After handling the elixir matter, Chen Ji suddenly stopped and turned his head to look at Su Qingyao.

Beneath the moonlight, her profile was as exquisite as a jade carving, yet an indescribable weariness lingered between her brows. Today she had traveled to investigate, and coming here late at night must have drained much of her energy.

『You...』 Su Qingyao seemed to sense his gaze and slightly turned her head. 『What are you looking at?』

『Nothing.』 Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, his voice calm. 『I just think you didn't need to wade into this murky business. Inner Sect Senior Fellow, a brilliant future ahead—why risk yourself for a waste like me?』

Upon hearing this, Su Qingyao snorted coldly: 『You still know you're a waste?』 Despite her harsh words, her tone held no genuine mockery, instead carrying an inexplicable emotion.

dialogue.content:
『The first time I saw you, I knew something was off.』

Su Qingyao suddenly spoke, her voice soft, as if thinking aloud: 『A waste of a disciple, yet his footing was steady as bedrock; a menial servant, yet he never befriended anyone deeply; clearly his cultivation was weak, yet he always managed to turn danger into safety at critical moments...』

She turned to meet Chen Ji's eyes directly: 『Do you know how long I've been investigating you?』

Chen Ji remained silent.

『Three years.』 Su Qingyao spoke each word with emphasis. 『Three whole years, and I couldn't find a single flaw. You were like a perfect waste, your disguise flawless.』 Her voice suddenly carried a tremor. 『But precisely because of that... I increasingly wanted to know who you really are.』

text.content:
From deep within the Bamboo Grove, a rustling sound suddenly arose.

Chen Ji abruptly raised his hand, shielding Su Qingyao behind him. His divine sense spread like a tide, then suddenly froze—in that instant.

That aura... it was the Tianji Record.

To be precise, it was the unique fluctuation emitted only when the Tianji Record Fragment resonated with something. And the source of that fluctuation was in... the direction of Ling Yuan's residence.

『What's wrong?』 Su Qingyao sensed his unusual reaction.

『Nothing.』 Chen Ji released his hand from her shoulder, his expression returning to normal. 『It's getting late. Go rest first. Tomorrow... we'll discuss strategy again.』

Yet his gaze couldn't help but turn toward the distance, a solemn gleam flickering in his eyes.

Ling Yuan, what exactly is your connection to the Tianji Record?

choice.prompt: A resonance occurred between the Tianji Record and the direction of Ling Yuan's residence. Chen Ji must take action tonight.

choices.text: Infiltrate under cover of night to investigate
choices.description: Seize the opportunity while Ling Yuan rests, quietly infiltrate his residence to investigate the source of that resonance
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk, may be discovered
choices.visible_reward: May uncover the true relationship between Ling Yuan and the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, will completely expose one's ambitions

text.content:
Chen Ji's figure flashed, vanishing into the night. His lightness skill had reached perfection—stepping on snow without leaving marks, rippling steps on water—this was the fruit of his three years of painstaking practice, merely never shown before others.

Ling Yuan's residence lay deep within the sect, shrouded in clouds and mist, its prohibitions layered重重. Yet Chen Ji moved through it as if entering an unguarded territory. Those prohibitions, under the protection of the Tianji Record, seemed to part like a path opened just for him.

Just as he was about to reach the entrance to Ling Yuan's secret chamber, a withered voice suddenly rang in his ear: 『Young fool, bold indeed.』

Chen Ji's heart sank heavily—he had been discovered.

choices.text: Hold position and observe the situation.
choices.description: Tonight is not suitable for hasty actions. Let's observe for a few days and wait for Ling Yuan to reveal more weaknesses.
choices.visible_cost: We might miss the first-mover advantage.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may seize this opportunity to set up a scheme.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji slowly withdrew his gaze and shook his head: "No rush. Since Ling Yuan took the initiative to show goodwill, he must have ulterior motives. If I act rashly now, I'll only fall into his trap."

He turned to look at Su Qingyao: "In the coming days, I will fully cooperate with his 'cooperation,' but secretly, you must keep a close eye on all his movements. Especially—"

His voice dropped to an extremely low whisper: "The connection between him and that 'vertical pupil.'"

Three days later.

In the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, Chen Ji stood respectfully behind the group of elders as a "waste disciple." Ling Yuan sat in the main seat, discussing sect affairs with several elders.

Chen Ji lowered his head and eyebrows, appearing to listen attentively, but his spiritual sense had been shrouding the entire hall. He was observing—observing every subtle movement of Ling Yuan, every change in his expression.

Suddenly, Ling Yuan's gaze swept over him, and a meaningful smile curled at the corner of his mouth.

"Chen Ji." The aged voice rang out, "Step forward."

Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his face showed only panic. He hurried forward with small steps and bowed respectfully: "This disciple is present."

Ling Yuan nodded and took out a token from his sleeve, handing it to him: "From today onward, you are this old man's registered disciple. You may freely enter and exit the sect's forbidden grounds."

At these words, a wave of whispered discussions immediately rose throughout the hall.

"What does the sect master mean by this? Taking a waste as a disciple?"

"Could Chen Ji have some special qualities?"

"Ridiculous! Our Tianqing Sect's dignified sect master actually takes a Foundation Building waste as a disciple!"

Ling Yuan's gaze swept across the crowd as he calmly said: "This old man's affairs are not for you to comment on."

An invisible pressure radiated from him, and everyone immediately fell silent.

Chen Ji lowered his head, took the token, but his heart was churning with waves.

What was Ling Yuan doing? Was taking him as a disciple a sign of trust, or was there another scheme?

What concerned him even more was—that at the moment he received the token, he clearly felt Ling Yuan's fingers lightly touch his palm, and in that instant, a familiar aura emanated from within Ling Yuan.

Heavenly Fate bloodline.

Just as he expected—there were traces of Heavenly Fate bloodline within Ling Yuan!

text.content:
After the council ended, Su Qingyao found Chen Ji at the sect's back mountain.

"Are you insane?" she demanded without preamble, "Becoming Ling Yuan's disciple means you will be completely exposed under his nose!"

But Chen Ji smiled—that smile carried a sense of exhilaration: "Yes, I intend to expose myself to him."

"What do you mean?"

"He wants to close the net, so let him close it." Chen Ji's voice was very soft, yet carried a chilling confidence, "But what he doesn't know is—that the moment I became his disciple, I had already set three hidden chess pieces."

He raised three fingers: "First, under his 'guidance,' I will cultivate the techniques he teaches, while secretly searching for the connection between him and the Heavenly Secrets. Second, with my disciple identity, I will enter the forbidden depths that he normally cannot access. Third..."

His gaze turned extremely sharp: "I will let him personally send me to that place—the place that holds the true secrets of the Tianji Record."

Su Qingyao stared at him blankly. At this moment, she finally realized how terrifying this "waste" truly was.

Night deepened, and the bamboo wave sounds of the back mountain rose and fell like the tide.

After Su Qingyao left, Chen Ji stood alone at the cliff edge, gazing down at the cloud-shrouded Tianqing Sect below. In his hand, the sect master's token glowed with a faint luminescence.

Suddenly, a familiar aged voice rang out in his mind—

"Boy, you're getting more and more interesting."

It was Mo Xiansheng.

Chen Ji's heart stirred, and his spiritual sense descended into the depths of the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sat cross-legged on the first page, and that blurred face seemed to carry a hint of a smile.

"What have you discovered about Ling Yuan?" Mo Xiansheng asked.

"There are traces of Heavenly Fate bloodline within him." Chen Ji answered truthfully, "Moreover... between him and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, there seems to be some kind of connection."

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then let out a meaningful sigh: "Boy, do you know that each generation's holder of the Tianji Record does not appear out of thin air, but is... chosen?"

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

"And Ling Yuan..." Mo Xiansheng's voice became drifting and ethereal, "was precisely the junior brother of the previous generation's Tianji Record holder."

Chen Ji's heart sank heavily.

So that was it.

No wonder Ling Yuan was so "favorably disposed" toward him, no wonder the Tianji Record had issued warnings—Ling Yuan was no cooperation partner at all, but rather... the loser of the previous generation's Tianji Record contest.

He hadn't lost to anyone else, but to the Tianji Record itself.

And now, with his eyes on Chen Ji, was it for cooperation, or to... reclaim what belonged to him?

The answer had already become clear.

Su Qingyao brought news: Ling Yuan had been the junior brother of the Tianji Record holder a hundred years ago.

This truth was like a basin of ice water, poured over Chen Ji's heart.

Junior brothers from a hundred years ago—now one had become the Tianqing Sect's sect master, while the other had fallen to a sect outcast. And that battle for the Tianji Record, the victor and vanquished were already self-evident.

Ling Yuan... he wasn't cooperating with Chen Ji, but waiting.

Waiting for an opportunity.

Waiting for Chen Ji to grow strong enough to open the Tianji Record's deeper seals.

Then, take everything.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, cold light flickering in his pupils. A cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth—

Old fox, you think you're the hunter, but what you don't know is that you are the chess piece I've set in place.

In this game, he would make Ling Yuan lose even his underwear.
